title: Colored Patterns
description: This resource pack changes the flag templates, making them more colorful and interesting.
body:
![the main image for Colored Patterns](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05d516d06065b76282de8c5420617afe271ce779.png)
**The resource pack changes the appearance of the flag patterns, adding color and interest, and making them more visible.**

---

**What is he changing**
- _changes the appearance of all 10 flag patterns_
- _makes them more visible to the eye._
